items.title: datasette-charts 0.4a0
items.brief: 新增图表类型插件钩子，但作者自己还没用它做过任何东西
items.summary: Release: datasette-charts 0.4a0 The new datasette-charts plugin has its own plugin hook to allow other plugins to define new chart types, but I hadn't actually used it for anything yet.
items.author: Simon Willison

items.title: datasette-mcp 0.4
items.brief: 修复与 Datasette 1.0a44 的兼容问题，适配新版接口
items.summary: Release: datasette-mcp 0.4 Fixed for compatibility with Datasette 1.0a44 . Tags: model-context-protocol , datasette
items.author: Simon Willison

items.title: Quoting Jack Despain Zhou
items.brief: AI 让表达趋同，YouTube 视频和会议演讲听起来都像 Claude
items.summary: Among the many already existing effects of AI has been a great de-individualization. I open a YouTube video, and I hear Claude. I sit in a conference presentation, and I hear Claude.
items.author: Simon Willison

items.title: sqlite3_rsync: Database Remote-Copy Tool For SQLite
items.brief: SQLite 3.47 起内置的实验性工具，今天才被注意到有独特优势
items.summary: sqlite3_rsync: Database Remote-Copy Tool For SQLite This additional SQLite tool has been around for a while now - it was added as "experimental" in SQLite 3.47.0 in October 2024 and enhanced in SQLite 3.50.0 in May 2025 . It was only today that I understood one of its most attractive characteristics.
items.author: Simon Willison

items.title: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features
items.brief: 纽约时报提醒摄影师别升级 Photoshop，担心 AI 功能改动照片
items.summary: My comment on The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features — Hacker News. I had a NYT photographer take my picture at my home earlier this year (for a story about Moltbook, oddly enough).
items.author: Simon Willison

items.title: Quoting Scott Aaronson
items.summary: It’s now obvious that we’ll be getting, not one-off solutions to this or that complexity question, but a whole new continent of mathematical truth, one that we’d previously only glimpsed through fog. Picture van Leeuwenhoek first training a microscope on pondwater, or Galileo first training his telescope on the stars.
items.author: Simon Willison

items.title: IRTIQA: Evolving in English, Evaluated in Urdu -- Does Agent Self-Evolution Transfer from English to Urdu and Code-Switched Input?
items.brief: 发布 IRTIQA 基准，检验智能体自进化能否从英语迁移到乌尔都语
items.summary: As LLM agents increasingly learn from their own experience, the tasks they learn from and are evaluated on are almost always in English. We ask whether self-evolution transfers from English to Urdu, and release IRTIQA, a benchmark of aligned English, Urdu-translated, and Urdu code-switched variants…
items.author: Abdullah Hashmat, Danish Javed, Usman Naseem

items.title: $μ$-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-User Task Completion in Shared Interaction Voice Agents
items.summary: Voice agents in shared spaces must satisfy interdependent multi-user requests while upholding per-user authority, privacy, and task constraints. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage when participants react throughout a session.
items.author: Qihao Lin, Guanxu Chen, Shuhang Zheng

items.title: Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
items.summary: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out?
items.author: Dezhi Luo, Fengyuan Yu, Haotian Zhang

items.title: Attack Policy Selection can Mislead Monitor Evaluators
items.summary: AI monitors, classifiers that flag dangerous behaviour by AI agents, are often evaluated against transcripts generated by attack policies acting as proxies for dangerous behaviour in deployment.
items.author: Charlie Griffin, Oliver Makins, Asa Cooper Stickland
